post_text: Ananya Birla-led Svatantra Microfin Limited has filed its DRHP with SEBI for a proposed ₹3,000 crore IPO. Svatantra Microfin has filed its DRHP with SEBI for a ₹3,000 crore IPO: ➟ ₹1,500 crore fresh issue ➟ ₹1,500 crore Offer for Sale ➟ Fresh issue proceeds to strengthen Tier-I capital and support future lending growth ➟ Microfinance AUM of ₹21,093 crore as of March 2026 ➟ Gross Stage-3 ratio improved to 1.19% in FY26 from 2.24% in FY25. No single district contributes more than 2.74% of microfinance AUM. Look beyond growth: Check Geographic concentration, Asset quality, Borrower leverage, Collection efficiency, Capital adequacy.
